text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян and I go to the Japanese
Derby to
watch Эйсин Флэш run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although Эйсин Флэш may be far from
the
favorite to win, she overturns
expectations and
seizes victory. The
stands erupt in excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It'd be difficult to get people as
enthused for a
race as the spectacle we
just witnessed solely by
promoting on
social media.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Realizing this, Каррен Тян grows
determined to
become cuter in order to
win over the hearts of
even more people.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hoping to gain the necessary skills to
accomplish
her goal, she decides to run
in the Hakodate
Sprint Stakes as part of
her training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
